tasks.subject: Task 1: Root UBI_10 repository
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Declare `UBI_10` in `root/project.yaml` so every inheriting project (`common:deps:*`, `ppg:common:deps`, `ppg:staging:14`–`18`, `ppg:devel:*`) gains it.

**Files:**
- Modify: `root/project.yaml:44-54` (insert the new block between the `UBI_9` block ending at line 54 and `- name: UBI_8` at line 55)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `root/project.yaml` has a `UBI_10` repository with paths `common:deps:build/UBI_10`, `${REMOTE_OBS_ORG_INTERCONNECT}Fedora:EPEL:10/standard`, `RedHat:UBI-10/standard`, `${REMOTE_OBS_ORG_INTERCONNECT}RockyLinux:10/devel`, archs `[x86_64, aarch64]`, placed directly after `UBI_9`.
- [ ] Resolved config of `common:deps:build` lists `UBI_10` between `UBI_9` and `UBI_8`.
- [ ] Rendered meta of `ppg:staging:18` and `ppg:common:deps` contains `<repository name="UBI_10">` with the `ppg:common:deps`/`UBI_10` path first on the staging project.
- [ ] `project verify` reports no error; `pytest -q` still passes 369 tests.

**Verify:** `venv/bin/python -m percona_obs -P labsmain project config --offline --resolved common:deps:build | grep -n "^- name: "` → three lines in order `UBI_9`, `UBI_10`, `UBI_8`.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["root/project.yaml"], "verifyCommand": "venv/bin/python -m percona_obs -P labsmain project config --offline --resolved common:deps:build | grep -n '^- name: '", "acceptanceCriteria": ["UBI_10 block after UBI_9 with the four paths and both archs", "resolved common:deps:build lists UBI_9, UBI_10, UBI_8", "ppg:staging:18 and ppg:common:deps meta contain UBI_10", "project verify clean, pytest 369 passed"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Staging tier prjconf for UBI_10
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Apply the `RockyLinux_10` build configuration of the staging tier to `UBI_10` as well.

**Files:**
- Modify: `root/ppg/staging/subprojects.yaml:40` (the `%if "%_repository" == "RockyLinux_10"` line)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] The staging tier `%if` for `RockyLinux_10` also matches `UBI_10`, covering `Prefer: selinux-policy-targeted`, `Prefer: hdf-libs` and the `%__brp_check_rpaths %{nil}` macro.
- [ ] Rendered build config of `ppg:staging:18` and `ppg:devel:18` contains the widened line.
- [ ] `pytest -q` still passes.

**Verify:** `venv/bin/python -m percona_obs -P labsmain project config --offline ppg:staging:18 | grep -n 'RockyLinux_10'` → exactly one line: `%if "%_repository" == "RockyLinux_10" || "%_repository" == "UBI_10"`.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["root/ppg/staging/subprojects.yaml"], "verifyCommand": "venv/bin/python -m percona_obs -P labsmain project config --offline ppg:staging:18 | grep -n RockyLinux_10", "acceptanceCriteria": ["%if line widened to RockyLinux_10 || UBI_10", "staging:18 and devel:18 build config contain the widened line", "pytest passes"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: UBI_10 in the opt-out projects (extras, tde)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Give the two projects that declare their own UBI repositories (`repositories-inherit: false`) a `UBI_10` repository and matching prjconf block.

**Files:**
- Modify: `root/ppg/staging/_shared/extras/project.yaml:13-38` (repository list and prjconf; symlinked as `16/extras`, `17/extras`, `18/extras`)
- Modify: `root/ppg/staging/16/tde/project.yaml:70-84` (repositories) and `:182-186` (prjconf)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `ppg:staging:18:extras` meta has `UBI_9`, `UBI_10` (and the `ubi9` image repo from `extras/containers` is unaffected).
- [ ] `ppg:staging:16:tde` meta has `UBI_9`, `UBI_10`, `UBI_8`.
- [ ] Both projects' build config contains a `UBI_10` block with `Prefer: selinux-policy-targeted`, `Prefer: hdf-libs` and the `%__brp_check_rpaths` macro.
- [ ] `project verify` clean; `pytest -q` passes.

**Verify:** `for p in ppg:staging:18:extras ppg:staging:16:tde; do venv/bin/python -m percona_obs -P labsmain project config --offline $p | grep -o 'repository name="[^"]*"' | tr '\n' ' '; echo; done` → first line contains `repository name="UBI_10"` after `UBI_9`; second line is `repository name="UBI_9" repository name="UBI_10" repository name="UBI_8"`.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["root/ppg/staging/_shared/extras/project.yaml", "root/ppg/staging/16/tde/project.yaml"], "verifyCommand": "for p in ppg:staging:18:extras ppg:staging:16:tde; do venv/bin/python -m percona_obs -P labsmain project config --offline $p | grep -o 'repository name=\"[^\"]*\"' | tr '\\n' ' '; echo; done", "acceptanceCriteria": ["extras meta has UBI_10 after UBI_9", "tde meta has UBI_9, UBI_10, UBI_8", "both build configs contain the UBI_10 block with the three RockyLinux_10 settings", "project verify clean, pytest passes"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: UBI_10: false where UBI_9 is disabled
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Keep the four packages that are switched off on `UBI_9` switched off on `UBI_10`, so the new repository builds exactly the `UBI_9` package set.

**Files:**
- Modify: `root/common/deps/build/llvm-21/package.yaml:15`
- Modify: `root/ppg/common/deps/bison/package.yaml:5`
- Modify: `root/ppg/common/deps/flex/package.yaml:5`
- Modify: `root/ppg/common/deps/nlohmann-json/package.yaml:5`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Each of the four files has `  UBI_10: false` on the line right after `  UBI_9: false`.
- [ ] No other `package.yaml` under `root/` mentions `UBI_10` (in particular none of the `RockyLinux_10: false` packages such as atlas, boost, lapack, perl-JSON, python3-systemd).
- [ ] `project verify` clean; `pytest -q` passes.

**Verify:** `grep -rlI "UBI_10: false" root --include=package.yaml | sort` → exactly the four paths above.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["root/common/deps/build/llvm-21/package.yaml", "root/ppg/common/deps/bison/package.yaml", "root/ppg/common/deps/flex/package.yaml", "root/ppg/common/deps/nlohmann-json/package.yaml"], "verifyCommand": "grep -rlI 'UBI_10: false' root --include=package.yaml | sort", "acceptanceCriteria": ["four files gain UBI_10: false after UBI_9: false", "no other package.yaml mentions UBI_10", "project verify clean, pytest passes"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Diff against labs and hand the branch to the user
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove, against the live labs instance, that the branch changes only add `UBI_10` (no orphan deletions, no unrelated diffs), then hand over for push and PR.

**Files:**
- No file changes. Read-only OBS calls through the `labsmain` profile.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `project config --diff` for `common:deps:build`, `ppg:common:deps`, `ppg:staging:18`, `ppg:staging:18:extras`, `ppg:staging:16:tde` and `ppg:devel:18` shows only `+` lines that mention `UBI_10` (a new `<repository>` element and the prjconf lines), no `-` lines.
- [ ] `git log percona/main..HEAD --oneline` lists the spec commits plus the four implementation commits, and `git status` is clean apart from the untracked `venv`/`.profile` symlinks.
- [ ] The user has been given the exact push command and PR label to use. Never push or create the PR yourself.

**Verify:** `venv/bin/python -m percona_obs -P labsmain project config --diff ppg:staging:18 | grep '^[-+]' | grep -v '^[-+][-+]' | grep -vc 'UBI_10'` → `0` (every changed line mentions `UBI_10`).

```json:metadata
{"files": [], "verifyCommand": "venv/bin/python -m percona_obs -P labsmain project config --diff ppg:staging:18 | grep '^[-+]' | grep -v '^[-+][-+]' | grep -vc UBI_10", "acceptanceCriteria": ["diff against labs shows only + lines mentioning UBI_10 for the six projects", "branch has the expected commits and a clean tree", "user told: git push rdias ubi10-repo, PR against percona/obs-packaging with label UBI_10"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Triage the first UBI_10 build round on labs
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Every package that is `succeeded` on `UBI_9` in the PR project is `succeeded` on `UBI_10` for both architectures; each exception is either fixed on the branch or given a documented `UBI_10: false`.

**Files:**
- Modify (as needed, only these kinds): `root/**/package.yaml` (`UBI_10: false` with a one-line comment), `root/project.yaml`, `root/ppg/common/deps/project.yaml`, `root/common/deps/runtime/project.yaml`, `root/ppg/staging/subprojects.yaml`, `root/ppg/staging/_shared/extras/project.yaml`, `root/ppg/staging/16/tde/project.yaml` (a `UBI_10` `Prefer:`/`Ignore:`/`Substitute:` line inside an existing or new `%if` block).

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] For each of `common:deps:build`, `common:deps:runtime`, `ppg:common:deps`, `ppg:staging:14`…`18`, `ppg:staging:16:extras`, `17:extras`, `18:extras`, `ppg:staging:16:tde`: the set of packages `succeeded` on `UBI_10` (x86_64 and aarch64) equals the set `succeeded` on `UBI_9`, minus packages explicitly given `UBI_10: false` with a comment on this branch.
- [ ] No package is `unresolvable`, `failed` or `broken` on `UBI_10` in the PR project.
- [ ] Every fix commit explains the OBS symptom it addresses in its message.

**Verify:** `venv/bin/python -m percona_obs -P labspr build status --repo UBI_10 ppg:staging:18 | awk '/^[├└]── /{pkg=$2} /UBI_10/ && !/succeeded|disabled|excluded/{print pkg": "$0}'` → no output (repeat for each project in the list above).

```json:metadata
{"files": [], "verifyCommand": "venv/bin/python -m percona_obs -P labspr build status --repo UBI_10 ppg:staging:18 | awk '/^[├└]── /{pkg=$2} /UBI_10/ && !/succeeded|disabled|excluded/{print pkg\": \"$0}'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["UBI_10 succeeded set equals UBI_9 succeeded set minus commented UBI_10: false packages, per project", "no unresolvable/failed/broken on UBI_10 in the PR project", "each fix commit cites the OBS symptom"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
